data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate recorded an overall release on prior-year reserves in 2014. A surplus of GBP 21.1m (net) was recognised in the calendar-year technical result relating to the reassessment of prior accident years, driven by favourable claims development (and reinsurance recoveries) across the portfolio. The year was relatively quiet for major catastrophes, and underwriting divisions benefited from closed-year releases.

data.data_quality_notes: Gross prior-year movement (GROSS change in provision for prior years) was not clearly stated in the syndicate-level notes that were accessible. The report explicitly states a net surplus of GBP 21.1m relating to reassessment of prior accident years (this is NET of reinsurance) and a gross movement figure could not be identified unambiguously. Therefore prior_year_development_gbp_m uses the NET figure (-21.1m) as a fallback. No unambiguous gross prior-year movement or a clearly labelled gross 'Movement in prior year's provision for claims outstanding' (insurance liabilities column) was found for Syndicate 510 in the extracted pages. If a gross movement note or a gross claims development triangle is present elsewhere in the full report, that should be used in preference to the net figure reported here.
